common.selectWorkspace: Select a workspace to use work tracking.
common.forbidden: Only internal admins can do this.
common.githubTokenMissing: Add a GitHub token for this repo in work settings first.
common.triageRequired: Triage this item before creating a GitHub issue.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: Work from every source in one place. Agents sort new items before people pick them up.
inbox.search: Filter by title, label or number
inbox.shortcuts: Press c to create, j and k to move, Enter to open.

empty.agents: No agents are working on anything.

inbox.boardShortcuts: Drag cards between columns to change their state. Press c to create.
inbox.shortcutsBulk: Press c to create, j and k to move, x to select, Enter to open. Shift-click selects a range.

create.title: New item
create.description: New items go to triage unless you pick a state.
create.repoInvalid: Use the owner/name form, for example acme/api.

item.duplicateDescription: Enter the number of the item this one duplicates. The item is cancelled and linked.
item.duplicateInvalid: Enter an item number such as 42.
item.requestsPrivate: Private. Request text and contact details stay in Phaseo: they're never copied to GitHub or sent to the engineer agent.
item.estimateInvalid: Use a whole number from 0 to 21 for the estimate.
item.markdownHint: Markdown works. Press Ctrl+Enter to save or Escape to cancel.
item.subscribeHint: Get notified about comments and changes on this item.
item.commentHint: Markdown works. Type @ to mention someone.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Companies that send asks. Requests are matched to customers by email domain.
customers.name: Name
customers.noItems: No items are linked to this customer.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Asks from customers. Create an item, link one to an existing item or dismiss it.
requests.subject: Subject
requests.private: Request text is private. It's never copied to GitHub or sent to the engineer agent.

errors.title: Errors
errors.description: Errors from your apps, grouped by type and stack. New and reopened groups can create items on their own.
errors.noFrames: The last event had no stack frames.
errors.sourceMapped: Mapped to your source with this release's source maps. The minified location is below each line.

settings.title: Work settings
settings.description: Connect intake forms, error reporting and GitHub repos. Secrets are shown once, when you create them.
settings.secretOnce: Copy this now. It won't be shown again.

intake.title: Intake forms
intake.description: Public forms that turn customer asks into requests.
intake.name: Form name

projects.title: Error projects
projects.description: Each app that reports errors gets its own key.
projects.name: Project name

github.title: GitHub repos
github.description: Linked repos sync issues and pull requests with work items, and can run the engineer agent when someone tags @phaseo.
github.tokenHint: Optional. Needs read and write access to issues on this repo. It's stored encrypted and used to create issues.
github.stepSecretToken: Add a repository secret named PHASEO_WORK_TOKEN with the bridge token.
github.stepSecretKey: Add a repository secret named PHASEO_API_KEY with a Phaseo API key. The engineer agent's usage is billed to it.
github.stepCommit: Commit the workflow as .github/workflows/phaseo.yml on the default branch.
github.stepSecretPrToken: Optional: add a secret named PHASEO_PR_TOKEN with a fine-grained token (contents and pull requests, read and write) so your checks run on the agent's pull requests.

tracker.title: Tracker
tracker.description: Response targets, stalled items and the agents that follow up. Only workspace owners and admins can change these.
tracker.slaHint: Hours from creation, or from a priority change, until an item is due. Items with no priority have no SLA.
tracker.stallHint: Open items with no activity for this long count as stalled.
tracker.ambientHint: An agent comments on stalled items and notifies their assignee.
tracker.ambientExperimental: Experimental. Follow-ups also need to be switched on for the deployment, and they may change.
tracker.supportDraftsHint: When an item with customer requests is done, the support agent drafts a reply for a person to review and send.
tracker.slaInvalid: Use whole hours from 1 to 2,160 for each priority.
tracker.readOnly: Only workspace owners and admins can change these settings.

mine.title: Your email
mine.description: Only for you, in this workspace.
mine.emailDigestHint: Unread notifications come in one short email, at most every 10 minutes. Anything you read here first isn't emailed.
mine.emailUnavailable: Work email isn't turned on for Phaseo yet. Your choice is kept for when it is.

errorTools.loadFailed: This project's tools couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.
errorTools.sourcemapsHint: Upload your build's source maps for each release, and stack traces show your original files and lines. Uploads use a separate token: the project key in your pages is public.
errorTools.sourcemapsUnavailable: Source map storage isn't set up on this Phaseo server yet, so uploads are turned down for now.
errorTools.rulesHint: Drop errors you don't care about, or give new error items to a person. A match is any part of the text, ignoring case.
errorTools.noReleases: No releases reported yet. Send a release with each error to see them here.

board.label: Board
board.dragInstructions: To move an item, press space, use the arrow keys to pick a column, then press space again. Press escape to cancel.

bulk.label: Bulk actions
bulk.labelsHint: Prefix a label with - to remove it. Separate labels with spaces or commas.

views.title: Views
views.name: Name
views.saveDescription: Saves the current filters and layout.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Group items into bodies of work with a lead and a target date.
projects.dialogDescription: Progress counts done items out of all items in the project.
projects.name: Name
projects.descriptionPlaceholder: What this project delivers. Markdown works.
projects.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Its items stay, without a project.
projects.noItems: No items in this project yet.

cycles.title: Cycles
cycles.description: Time-boxed periods of work. Unfinished items can roll over to the next cycle.
cycles.createDescription: The dates start after the latest cycle, for the same length.
cycles.burnUpCaption: Estimate points by day: scope, the ideal pace, and what was completed.
cycles.rolloverDescription: {count, plural, one {Move # unfinished item from {name} to the next cycle?} other {Move # unfinished items from {name} to the next cycle?}}
cycles.name: Name
cycles.datesInvalid: The end date must be after the start date.
cycles.rolledOver: {count, plural, one {Moved # item to the next cycle.} other {Moved # items to the next cycle.}}

insights.title: Insights
insights.createdVsClosedHint: Items opened and items done or cancelled each day.
insights.bySourceHint: Where new items came from each day.
insights.noneCreated: No items were created in this range.
insights.noRuns: No agent runs in this range.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.unreadCount: {count, plural, =0 {You're all caught up.} one {# unread} other {# unread}}

kinds.reply_draft: A reply draft is ready for review

palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Jump to an item, create one, switch views or go to a page.
palette.placeholder: Search items by number or title, or type a command…

replies.title: Reply drafts
replies.reviewNote: The support agent drafted these replies. Nothing is sent until you review a draft and confirm.
replies.noRecipient: No contact email on this request
replies.subject: Subject
replies.confirmDescription: The reply goes to {email} from your workspace. You can't unsend it.
replies.markedSent: Marked as sent. Send the reply from your own email.
replies.markedSentCopied: Marked as sent and copied. Paste it into your own email to send it.

attachments.none: No files yet. Files stay in Phaseo and are never sent to GitHub or agents.
attachments.unavailable: File storage isn't set up on this Phaseo server yet.

reactions.toggle: {emoji}, {count}. Press to add or remove yours.

milestones.empty: No milestones yet. Break the project into steps, then put items in them from the item page.
milestones.name: Milestone name

projectUpdates.title: Updates
projectUpdates.empty: No updates yet. Post one to say how the project is going.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Starting points for items you make often, and items that repeat on a schedule.
templates.dialogDescription: A new item made from this template starts with these fields.
templates.name: Template name
templates.deleteConfirm: Delete the {name} template? Its repeating schedules stop too.
templates.repeatDescription: A new item is made from the template on this schedule.
templates.firstOnHint: Leave empty to make the first item now. Later items follow at the same time of day.

integrations.title: API and webhooks
integrations.description: Let scripts and other tools read and change items, and tell your services when items change.
integrations.loadFailed: API keys and webhooks couldn't be loaded. Try again in a moment.
integrations.readOnly: Only workspace owners and admins can add or change API keys and webhooks.
integrations.secretOnce: Copy this now. It won't be shown again.
integrations.keysHint: Read keys list and read items and projects. Write keys can also create items, change them and comment. Customer requests are never available through the API.
integrations.revokeConfirm: Revoke {name}? Anything using it stops working straight away.
integrations.webhooksHint: New item events are sent each minute, signed with the webhook's secret. A webhook turns off after 20 failed sends in a row.
